repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies Valve.Close as a one-time action before the cycle, while EmailProvider.SendMail executes every cycle. The candidate script places Valve.Close in the else branch of the periodic wrapper, causing it to repeat every 60 seconds (F2 mismatch at 60000ms). Removing Valve.Close from the else block preserves the one-time execution in the first iteration and the repeated execution of SendMail.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed (#Laundry_Valve).valve_close() from the else branch to prevent repeated valve closure while maintaining periodic email sending.
